work: The de Broglie relation is lambda = h/(mv). The momentum is p = mv = (9.109e-31 kg)(2.00e6 m/s) = 1.8218e-24 kg m/s. Dividing h = 6.626e-34 J s by this momentum gives lambda = 6.626e-34 / 1.8218e-24 = 3.64e-10 m. This is about 0.36 nm, the expected scale for a fast electron.
